title: Prepare college_classroom Infinigen scene for SPEAR
objective: Export the provided Infinigen college_classroom Blender scene, import it into SpearSim as a distinct Unreal map, cook/package it, and report the runnable simulator command.
instructions: Verify the provided scene.blend and generator script exist before starting.
Use the existing Infinigen-to-SPEAR workflow and examples/flashlight/setup_infinigen_indoors.py rather than inventing a new import path unless blocked.

Export an FBX from /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/college_classroom/coarse/scene.blend into a dedicated output folder under /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/college_classroom, preferring a lighter export resolution first if appropriate based on prior one_bed_apartment experience.
Import the FBX into SpearSim under /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/college_classroom/Meshes and create/save /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/college_classroom/Maps/college_classroom.
Use replacement flags only for the college_classroom target paths; do not disturb previous infinigen_indoors_0000 or one_bed_apartment assets.
For first-pass reliability, consider disabling auto collision, material import, and texture import if the FBX is large, matching the validated one_bed_apartment approach.
Cook/package the imported college_classroom map into the local SpearSim standalone build.
If long-running steps are needed, run them in a clearly named tmux session and report the session name.
constraints: Do not commit, push, rebase, or perform Git state changes.
Do not edit unrelated product code or docs.
Do not overwrite any non-college_classroom Unreal content target.
expected_outputs: Absolute paths to the exported FBX, imported map, logs, and any tmux session used.
The exact command the user should run to launch the college_classroom map through examples/flashlight/run.py.
A concise summary of asset counts, approximate size/performance risks, and whether visual/runtime validation remains pending.
